details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: mount option injection via credentials file values
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-104715.patch: in mount.cifs.c, reject
       username= and domain= values from a credentials file, and the USER
       environment variable or passwd login name, that contain an option
       delimiter (comma, equals, CR or LF) before they are assembled into
       the kernel mount option string.
     - CVE-2026-104715
